resource.title: Resource
resource.description: UKG Pro WFM resource to extract (one resource per configuration row).

load_type.title: Load Type
load_type.description: How rows are written to the table: full load replaces it each run; incremental load upserts by primary key

options.tooltip: This controls the Storage write mode only, not how much data is fetched — the fetch window is set by Start/End Date. Incremental load upserts by the Primary Key; a resource with no primary key always runs as a full replace.

since.title: Start Date
since.description: Lower bound of the fetch window

options.tooltip: ISO 8601 (e.g. `2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00`) or a relative phrase (e.g. `30 days ago`, `yesterday`). Independent of Load Type: on incremental load it seeds the first run (the stored watermark takes over afterwards); on full load, and for any keyless resource, it applies on every run.

until.title: End Date
until.description: Upper bound of the fetch window

options.tooltip: Optional. ISO 8601 (e.g. `2026-02-01T00:00:00+00:00`) or a relative phrase (e.g. `yesterday`, `now`). Leave empty to fetch up to the current run time; set it to bound a backfill to a fixed window.

The SQL-like query UKG WFM runs for the async payroll export (POST /commons/payroll/export/async). It is tenant-specific — use the export query your WFM tenant defines. Required for the Payroll Export resource.

hyperfind_ref.title: Hyperfind Query
hyperfind_ref.description: Employee set this resource is pulled for

options.tooltip: The Hyperfind query that resolves which employees this resource extracts. Click Load Hyperfinds and pick from the tenant's saved queries (public, personal, and system). Leave unset to fall back to 'All Home', which large tenants reject above their size threshold — pick a narrower query instead.

hyperfind_threshold.title: Hyperfind Threshold
hyperfind_threshold.description: Maximum number of employees the Hyperfind Query above may resolve before the request is rejected.

options.tooltip: UKG rejects a Hyperfind that resolves more employees than this cap with error WCO-112003. UKG's per-request default is low, so a broad Hyperfind ('All Home'/'All People') fails unless it is raised. Leave at 50000 unless your tenant roster is larger, or you want to cap the roster deliberately.

select.title: Select Fields
select.description: Optional list of API 'select' elements to request. Leave empty to use the resource default.

symbolic_period.title: Symbolic Period
symbolic_period.description: Optional symbolic period used instead of an explicit start/end date window.

options.tooltip: UKG-named relative period ranges (e.g. `Current Pay Period`, `Previous Pay Period`, `Yesterday`, `Today`) sent to the API instead of an explicit window. If set, it takes precedence and Start Date / End Date are ignored — configure EITHER a symbolic period OR an explicit Start/End window, not both. Applies only to date-windowed resources; ignored otherwise. See the UKG Pro WFM API reference: https://developer.ukg.com/wfm/reference

primary_key.title: Primary Key
primary_key.description: Column(s) that uniquely identify a row; used to upsert on incremental load. The dropdown lists the resource's output-table columns from Storage, so it is populated only after the first run has created the table — run once, then click Re-load.

options.tooltip: The output table's primary key. On incremental load the component upserts on these columns and writes the manifest incrementally. Columns are read from the resource's output table in Storage, so this is empty until the first extraction has created that table — run once, then re-load. Supplying a primary key also enables incremental upsert for a resource that has no key in the built-in registry. Leave empty to use the resource's registry default (a keyless resource then stays full-replace).

max_wait_seconds.title: Payroll Max Wait (seconds)
max_wait_seconds.description: Maximum time to poll a Payroll async export before failing (avoids hanging).

poll_interval_seconds.title: Payroll Poll Interval (seconds)
poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between Payroll async export status polls.
